title: GraphExtractResponse
description: Outcome of POST /v1/collections/{id}/graph (#350): which archived version the graph is extracted from and the job to poll. 202 in every accepted case — an extraction was submitted, or the version's graph leg already existed (job_id null).

version.description: The archived version the extraction reads (or already covers).

job_id.description: The job to poll at GET /v1/ingest/{job_id} (kind `graph`); null when the version already had its graph leg and nothing was submitted.

submission_id.description: The workflow-engine submission id when THIS call submitted the extraction; null otherwise.
